summary: Preprint Supplemental Fig. 1b reports male- and female-biased expression across the 530 P10 cells passing the initial filter. HypoExplorer sums 467 retained VMH neurons into six mouse pseudobulks and estimates male-minus-female expression across animals. The published cluster markers and adult in situ measurements also answer different questions.

manualReview.summary: Figure 2 identifies the registered P10 VMH cohort. The public sex-DE volcano uses individual cells from a broader cohort.
manualReview.note: The GEO count archive and Figure 2 cell map match their recorded SHA-256 values. Reapplying the initial QC gate to 576 wells retained 261 female and 269 male cells. All 467 Figure 2 IDs passed, yielding 237 female and 230 male VMH cells across three mice per sex after the Apoe/Pomc exclusions. The registered edgeR quasi-likelihood coefficient compares male with female mouse pseudobulks. Preprint Supplemental Fig. 1b compares the initially filtered cells by sex, including the divergent clusters. Published Figure 2 reports cluster markers and per-cell expression. Figure 3 and its workbook report optical-density differences in sections from separate adult animals.
reviewFlags: No public author gene effects were located for the retained P10 cells aggregated by mouse. Author agreement, P values and FDR for this contrast remain unassessed.

The current compressed GEO SOFT differs from the historical checksum. Its tissue, age, sex, genotype, GSM identifiers and file links support the same cohort. The checksum match applies to the count archive and Figure 2 CSV.

verificationReview.reason: Preprint Supplemental Fig. 1b has the same P10 source mice and labels positive average logFC as male-biased, but the authors compared all 530 initially filtered cells by sex. The registered model estimates a log2 fold change with three male and three female mouse pseudobulks built from 467 VMH cells after the Apoe/Pomc exclusions. The final paper's marker test compares clusters. Its gene-specific sex-by-region tests use adult tissue optical density. None supplies an effect for the registered animals-as-replicates contrast.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen if an author result documents gene effects for male versus female across the six P10 mice using the Figure 2 VMH cells aggregated within each mouse. Record the effect definition, baseline and gene scope, and assess P values or FDR only where supplied.
